name: What kind of maintenance is required for exterior trim?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance is required for exterior trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance depends largely on the material. Wood trim typically requires regular cleaning, scraping loose paint, re-caulking, and repainting or re-staining every few years to prevent rot and maintain its appearance. Engineered wood and fiber cement trims are more durable but still benefit from occasional cleaning and paint touch-ups. PVC and composite trims are generally low-maintenance, requiring only periodic cleaning with soap and water to remove dirt and mildew. Regular inspections for damage are important for all types.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance varies by material: wood needs regular painting/staining, while engineered wood, fiber cement, and PVC require less, mainly periodic cleaning and inspections.
